wire.headline: Utility firm reports profit decline and announces job cuts and plant closures
sentences: The company reported that revenue rose by 7% year-over-year to 4.26bn GBP for the quarter ending on 30 September.
Pre-tax profit fell by 12% to reach 310m GBP.
The firm plans to cut 850 jobs, which represents about 6% of its workforce.
Two gas plants are scheduled to close by March 2027, with one located in Wales and the other in Kent.
CEO Marian Holt stated that cost pressure was sharper than expected.
Ofgem has opened an investigation into the company's billing system.
The dividend has been held steady at 12.4p a share.
Shares dropped by 4.2% during morning trading.

ND.headline: Energy Firm Announces Job Cuts and Profit Decline Amid Regulatory Scrutiny

sentences.text: The company reported a pre-tax profit of 310m GBP, which represents a 12% decrease.
A total of 850 jobs are being cut, accounting for approximately 6% of the workforce.
An analyst from Kestrel Securities stated that the job cuts will save 90m GBP annually.
The union Unite intends to ballot its members on taking industrial action.
The plant in Kent employs 410 staff, leaving the local supply chain exposed.

Since 2024, 1,200 staff have left the company through a voluntary scheme.
